meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 它当你的写作搭档:一起搭文章大纲、查资料并附上引用、帮你改开头 hook、逐段给反馈,同时尽量保留你自己的文风与语气。
howto.when: 当你写博客、深度文章或技术文档时接管;想让开头 hook 更有吸引力,或写完一节想要反馈时也会介入。

say.text: 帮我为『AI 对产品管理的影响』列一份文章大纲
say.note: 它会先问主题、受众和篇幅,再给出大纲。

say.text: 这是我写好的开头,帮我把 hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 它会给出几种改写方案和各自理由。

say.text: 我刚写完『为什么这很重要』这一节,给我反馈
say.note: 它按清晰度、行文、证据、风格逐条点评。

howto.what_en: It acts as a writing partner: builds outlines with you, researches topics and adds citations, improves your hook, reviews each section, and keeps your own voice and tone.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you write blog posts, articles, or technical docs; also when you want a stronger hook or section-by-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about AI and product management
say_en.note: It asks about topic, audience and length, then drafts an outline.

say_en.text: Here's my introduction. Help me make the hook more compelling.
say_en.note: It offers several rewrites with reasons.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it and give feedback.
say_en.note: It reviews clarity, flow, evidence and style.
